subject.title: improve(gateway): bound visible history page reads

question: Should the gateway retain numeric `nextCursor` responses for existing clients and introduce opaque visible-history cursors through a versioned or negotiated contract, or intentionally make the opaque response a breaking API change?
rationale: The implementation changes a public response field and adds an installed plugin-SDK import surface; source inspection establishes the compatibility tradeoff, but only maintainers can choose the permanent external contract.

options.title: Version or negotiate opaque cursors
options.body: Keep legacy numeric `nextCursor` responses by default and expose the opaque generation-aware cursor through an explicit API version, opt-in parameter, or additive field.

options.title: Accept a documented breaking transition
options.body: Deliberately replace the response cursor with the opaque token and publish a migration window and client-impact rationale.

options.title: Pause the public cursor change
options.body: Land only the internal bounded-read work after separating the external cursor and SDK-surface decisions.

recommendation.title: Version or negotiate opaque cursors
recommendation.body: Keep legacy numeric `nextCursor` responses by default and expose the opaque generation-aware cursor through an explicit API version, opt-in parameter, or additive field.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged cursor foundation and are the most directly connected contributor for explaining or narrowing the proposed public contract.
